function.name: sql_db_query_checker
function.arguments:
{"query": "SELECT city, '2022' AS year,
  ((COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_very_poor,0) + COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_severe,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2022_no_of_days___good,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_severe,0)
   ,0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_dangerous,
  ((COALESCE(2022_no_of_days___good,0) + COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_satisfactory,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2022_no_of_days___good,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2022_no_of_days_severe,0)
   ,0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_good_or_better
FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
UNION ALL
SELECT city, '2023' AS year,
  ((COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_very_poor,0) + COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_severe,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_severe,0)
   ,0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_dangerous,
  ((COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good,0) + COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_satisfactory,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_severe,0)
   ,0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_good_or_better
FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
UNION ALL
SELECT city, '2024' AS year,
  ((COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_very_poor,0) + COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_severe,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good1,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_severe,0)
   ,0)
  ) * 100 AS pct_dangerous,
  ((COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good1,0) + COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_satisfactory,0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
   / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(2023_no_of_days_good1,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_satisfactory,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_moderate,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_poor,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_very_poor,0)+COALESCE(2024_no_of_days_severe,0)

FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
ORDER BY city, year;"}

  / NULLIF((COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_good",0)+COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_satisfactory",0)+COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_moderate",0)+COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_poor",0)+COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_very_poor",0)+COALESCE("2022_no_of_days_severe",0))::DOUBLE PRECISION, 0::DOUBLE PRECISION))*100 AS pct_dangerous
FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
UNION ALL

 ((COALESCE("2023_no_of_days_very_poor",0)+COALESCE("2023_no_of_days_severe",0))::DOUBLE PRECISION

FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
UNION ALL
SELECT city, '2024' AS year,
 ((COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_very_poor",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_severe",0))::DOUBLE PRECISION
  / NULLIF((COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_good",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_satisfactory",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_moderate",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_poor",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_very_poor",0)+COALESCE("2024_no_of_days_severe",0))::DOUBLE PRECISION, 0::DOUBLE PRECISION))*100 AS pct_dangerous
FROM air_quality_index_major_indian_cities
ORDER BY city, year
LIMIT 100;
